title: Classify all first nonadditive P112 rank-59 diagonal completions
body:
This scoped classification gives every nonadditive rank-59 complex diagonal completion of the doubled P112 Gram matrix. Exactly 112 supports form one orbit under the stated frame-preserving E8 group; one explicit reciprocal-coefficient equation is necessary and sufficient on each support. The inherited root-flat premises remain explicit. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f8cee42b6aa2d650de8b359061a2660031506fe8/research/p112-rank59-equality/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f8cee42b6aa2d650de8b359061a2660031506fe8/research/p112-rank59-equality/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f8cee42b6aa2d650de8b359061a2660031506fe8/research/p112-rank59-equality/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f8cee42b6aa2d650de8b359061a2660031506fe8/research/p112-rank59-equality/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 120 root normals, 112 equality supports, 1,344 affine maps, 18,816 plane actions, two literal 112-row ranks and six 53-row Gaussian-rational rank checks. Both print `PASS_P112_RANK59_CLASSIFICATION`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rank59-equality
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 40000608957](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40000608957). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Test a specified diagonal-repair consumer and charge its full decoder bill before using this algebraic rank reduction. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit @petalas's [PR #5249](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5249) supplies the exact model, rank stratification, rank-59 witness and equality question in its [pinned proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1c8bf3f3dadd1f6fd14892630eb76e984a74738a/research/p112-diagonal-rank-boundary/README.md). It retains @Arham-Tahir64's [PR #1313](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1313) diagonal-mask question and pivot method, @woklerx's [PR #1447](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1447) code-distance premise, and @themilkman216's [PR #968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/968) root-flat classification. @DreamingOfClouds and the retained E8/Hamming lineage keep their geometric credit. Rank-one determinant identities and the affine-plane model are classical. The new result is the complete first nonadditive coefficient/support class and its specified symmetry quotient.

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
